Corollary
[Upper bound for $\mu $ when $\lambda \le 0$] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0026, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0027 ↗ lem:chow-iii-ch17-mu-upper-lambda-volume 1. ch17:17.4\group Entropy Bounds

If $\lambda (g)\le 0$, then \[ \mu (g,\tau )\le \log \Vol (g)-\frac n2\log (4\pi \tau )-n+\frac1e. \]
Proof

\sketch Use $\mu (g,\tau )=\mu (cg,c\tau )$ in the preceding lemma with $c=\Vol (g)^{-2/n}$, and use $\lambda (cg)=c^{-1}\lambda (g)\le 0$.

□
